title: Micro-plan metering + per-environment sandbox billing spec and acceptance criteria
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Define requirements and acceptance criteria for introducing "micro-plans": low-cost, finely-metered plans intended for developer sandboxes and ephemeral environments. This ticket captures metering semantics, per-environment toggles (sandbox vs production), prorations for mid-cycle seat/feature changes, tax/region invoice rules, and the billing-side acceptance tests required before launch.
background: Customers have asked for a lightweight developer experience that allows teams to create ephemeral environments without consuming main plan credits or causing billing noise. Existing plan entitlements are coarse-grained and cause unexpected invoices when trial environments spin up. Engineering has built a prototype metering endpoint (ENG-44821) that reports micro-events; product needs to define the packaging semantics and acceptance criteria so billing and invoices remain auditable.
scope_inclusions: Define micro-plan SKU characteristics: price per 1k micro-events, included free bucket (e.g., 2k events/month), and soft-overdraft behavior
Per-environment flag: sandbox vs production toggles billing path and reporting in the Console
Proration rules for mid-cycle seat and feature toggles specific to micro-plans
Invoice presentation: grouped micro-plan line item with environment metadata (env-id, owner) and region tax breakdown
Billing API endpoints: list active micro-plan subscriptions, suspend/resume micro-plan billing for a given env
scope_exclusions: Changes to existing enterprise reserved capacity contracts
Full redesign of current invoicing portal UI (only add micro-plan line item display)
Currency conversion engine improvements beyond presenting region-correct tax codes
acceptance_criteria: Metering: micro-events reported by runtime map 1:1 to billing units in staging; sampling/aggregation must not alter per-event counts
Soft-overdraft: when free micro-bucket exhausted, system must throttle to read-only API within 15s and emit billing alert to account owner
Proration: activating/deactivating a micro-plan mid-billing-cycle produces a proration credit or charge line that matches expected calculation for partial days
Invoice: staging invoices include a distinct micro-plan line item with environment tag; tax calculation uses the customer's billing address region and shows tax-rate and country code
Console: per-environment billing toggle visible and editable by owner; changes are audited and visible in the activity log
API: billing.list_subscriptions (internal) returns micro-plan entries with fields [sku, env_id, status, usage_this_cycle] (for acceptance tests we assert field presence)
End-to-end test: create a sandbox env, exercise 3x the free bucket, observe soft-overdraft throttle and single invoice line with correct amounts
Security: micro-plan metadata must not leak internal customer PII; metadata limited to env-id, team slug, and owner email hash
success_metrics: Reduce accidental production bill spikes due to dev sandboxes by 60% in Q2
Adoption: 20% of new trial orgs opt into micro-plan within first month
Accuracy: <0.01% divergence between runtime metering and billing counts across 30-day window in staging
rollout_plan: Alpha: enable micro-plan for Redwood internal orgs + a handful of invited customers (2 weeks)
Beta: open to customers via opt-in toggle in Console and API (4 weeks)
GA: on by default for new trial orgs and documented in pricing catalog (post-beta + release cycle)
Monitoring: add billing reconciliation dashboard and daily diff alert for >0.1% drift
qa_checks: Unit tests for proration math with edge cases (timezone boundaries, DST, leap seconds)
Integration test that simulates concurrent env creation and teardown under load
Manual invoice inspection for customers in EU, US, and APAC to validate tax rows
Security review checklist: ensure no PII in invoice metadata and env ownership permissions validated
Performance: generating micro-plan invoice line across 10k envs must complete within billing-job SLA
decisions: Default free bucket: 2,000 micro-events/month per micro-plan (decided 2026-03-11 after cost modelling)
Soft-overdraft action will be throttled read-only (not hard block) and accompanied by an alert email to env owner
Micro-plan metadata on invoices limited to env-id, env-name (optional), and region code to satisfy audit requirements while minimizing PII
